content.title: The Toll Road
content.theme: A mechanic demo: a fortified tidal pass where every trap on the road shows you its hardware before it uses it.
content.premise: The tide road to Vesper Keep is the only dry way inland, and the keep still collects its toll. Ordwin the Tollwright meets travellers at the barrow shore and explains the arrangement: the road takes payment in attention. Three tolls stand between the shore and the vault, and each one shows you its hardware before it uses it — a plate, a slot, a lever. Ordwin does not walk his own road.

boundary.message: The tide shoves you back onto the road.

content.outro: You paid the road in attention, and it let you keep your hands.
